bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest Bears story in the last 24 hours centers on the injury report ahead of Sunday's Week 11 matchup against the New Orleans Saints, which includes star defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons, listed as a limited participant with a knee issue, and cornerback Kyler Gordon , who had a DNP next to his name due to a shoulder injury . Despite the uncertainty, quarterback Caleb Williams has been focused on the road ahead, as he told reporters he's "moved on" from a four-interception performance and is ready for home stretch of playoff race .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions continue grappling with the fallout from Aidan Hutchinson's season-ending ACL tear, suffered while celebrating a sack during their win over the Patriots in Munich, with coach Dan Campbell saying he won't play the "what if' game following another injury to one of his key defenders . Amid the mounting injury list, there's a silver lining as Dan Campbell said Tuesday that he plans to get Kerby Joseph going in Week 11 against Tampa Bay after the safety started the season on the reserve/PUP list with a knee injury , while the team also made a corresponding roster move by re-claiming a depth edge rusher following the Hutchinson injury .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story is the Packers' trade with Pittsburgh for running back depth, acquiring Kaleb Johnson as they enter their mini-bye at 5-3, following a rough stretch that included a lopsided loss to the Vikings. The move comes as Green Bay also continues to track star edge rusher Micah Parsons, with head coach Matt LaFleur acknowledging Parsons could be ready to make his season debut following the Packers' bye week, though he still has a couple more hurdles to clear.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings are preparing for a high-profile Week 11 "Sunday Night Football" showdown against the San Francisco 49ers in Mexico City, with quarterback Kirk Cousins and the Vikings' defense riding high after their dominant win over the Green Bay Packers. Adding intrigue to the matchup, head coach Kevin O'Connell revealed positive news that Jordan Addison will avoid injured reserve for now after thumb surgery , even as the team continues adjusting its receiver rotation in his absence.
